measured_observation.scope: first development unit linear-seed7 B only, before independent report adjudication

assessment: The active study controls model identity, reasoning setting, task data, public tool permissions, literature input and global resource ceilings. It contrasts C against a minimal full-phase upstream adaptation; it does not identify C versus the recommended/default original iterative policy, because the B phase settings remove iterative MLE and paper improvement before the shared global ceiling is reached. A full-pipeline invocation is faithful source execution but is not original-default configuration fidelity.
claim_scope_allowed: Development integration/recovery/provenance and task performance under this exact minimal B configuration
Measured cost/resource utilization versus this explicitly configured baseline, conditional on independent acceptance
claim_scope_disallowed: Generic superiority over Agent Laboratory original defaults or paper configuration
Design improvement independent of the phase-allocation change
Empirical original-model versus current-model effect (A is unexecuted)

future_proposal.other_conditions: Register a separate study. Preserve current artifacts. Keep both arms on the same task/model/effort/literature/tool rights and shared request/CPU ceilings. Source phase tolerances should be restored or explicitly defended as domain adaptation. Do not supply final hidden answers. Freeze the tuned B policy before final evaluation.

source_based_cost_projection.qualification: Assumes immediate valid commands/judges and no literature/section retries. This is not an upper bound: original inner while loops, repairs and reward parse failures may add calls. The shared 51 host ceiling remains required, but a default-lit5 or constructor Paper5 policy may need a separately registered larger common ceiling to finish.

future_proposal.selection: Run development policy sensitivity at least recommended solver 3/1, optionally stronger task-appropriate MLE4/1 within registered resources. Pick policy from development evidence before fixed final tasks; classify observed pilot tasks as development.
